decisions.reason: Because it is close to the established prescription portfolio and was given a dedicated market presentation, management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep it while sales evidence accumulates.

As a more distant and price-pressured generic product that fits the firm's stated strategy less well than its differentiated core lines, it is the most likely candidate to be withdrawn and have its resources reassigned.
This close-to-core antihypertensive line already appears to have broader commitment through several models, so it is likely to stay unless performance falls clearly below aspiration.

Although its lighter website presence suggests a more cautious launch, it supports the firm's push into differentiated self-care products and is therefore likely to be retained for further market learning.
